parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::uuid AS job_id
)
SELECT
  input.job_id AS requested_job_id,
  jobs.id AS job_id,
  jobs.language_code,
  jobs.target_duration_seconds,
  jobs.status,
  jobs.current_stage,
  jobs.final_video_path,
  jobs.last_error,
  jobs.id IS NOT NULL AS job_exists,
  COUNT(scenes.id)::int AS scene_count,
  COALESCE(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'scene_id', scenes.id,
        'scene_number', scenes.scene_number,
        'narration', scenes.narration,
        'audio_path', scenes.audio_path,
        'duration_seconds', scenes.duration_seconds,
        'visual_path', scenes.visual_path,
        'status', scenes.status
      )
      ORDER BY scenes.scene_number
    ) FILTER (WHERE scenes.id IS NOT NULL),
    '[]'::jsonb
  ) AS scenes
FROM input
LEFT JOIN public.jobs
  ON jobs.id = input.job_id
LEFT JOIN public.scenes
  ON scenes.job_id = jobs.id
GROUP BY
  input.job_id,
  jobs.id,
  jobs.language_code,
  jobs.target_duration_seconds,
  jobs.status,
  jobs.current_stage,
  jobs.final_video_path,
  jobs.last_error;

WITH transitioned AS (
  UPDATE public.jobs
  SET
    current_stage = 'render',
    last_error = NULL,
    updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = $1::uuid
    AND status = 'processing'
    AND current_stage = 'visuals'
  RETURNING id, status, current_stage
),
resumed AS (
  UPDATE public.jobs
  SET
    status = 'processing',
    current_stage = 'render',
    last_error = NULL,
    updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = $1::uuid
    AND status = 'failed'
    AND current_stage = 'render'
  RETURNING id, status, current_stage
),
existing AS (
  SELECT id, status, current_stage
  FROM public.jobs
  WHERE id = $1::uuid
    AND status = 'processing'
    AND current_stage = 'render'
),
ready AS (
  SELECT id, status, current_stage, true AS started_now FROM transitioned
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id, status, current_stage, true AS started_now FROM resumed
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id, status, current_stage, false AS started_now FROM existing
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  $1::uuid AS job_id,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ready) AS ready_to_run,
  (SELECT status FROM ready LIMIT 1) AS status,
  (SELECT current_stage FROM ready LIMIT 1) AS current_stage,
  COALESCE((SELECT started_now FROM ready LIMIT 1), false) AS started_now;

WITH updated AS (
  UPDATE public.jobs
  SET
    final_video_path = $2::text,
    status = 'review_ready',
    current_stage = 'review',
    last_error = NULL,
    updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = $1::uuid
    AND status = 'processing'
    AND current_stage = 'render'
    AND NULLIF(BTRIM(final_video_path), '') IS NULL
  RETURNING id, status, current_stage, final_video_path
),
existing AS (
  SELECT id, status, current_stage, final_video_path
  FROM public.jobs
  WHERE id = $1::uuid
    AND status = 'review_ready'
    AND current_stage = 'review'
    AND final_video_path = $2::text
),
ready AS (
  SELECT id, status, current_stage, final_video_path, true AS transitioned FROM updated
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id, status, current_stage, final_video_path, false AS transitioned FROM existing
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  $1::uuid AS job_id,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ready) AS persisted,
  COALESCE((SELECT transitioned FROM ready LIMIT 1), false) AS transitioned,
  (SELECT status FROM ready LIMIT 1) AS status,
  (SELECT current_stage FROM ready LIMIT 1) AS current_stage,
  (SELECT final_video_path FROM ready LIMIT 1) AS final_video_path;

WITH updated AS (
  UPDATE public.jobs
  SET
    status = 'failed',
    current_stage = 'render',
    last_error = CASE
      WHEN status = 'failed' AND NULLIF(BTRIM(last_error), '') IS NOT NULL THEN last_error
      ELSE LEFT($2::text, 4000)
    END,
    updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = $1::uuid
    AND current_stage = 'render'
    AND status IN ('processing', 'failed')
  RETURNING id, status, current_stage, last_error
)
SELECT
  $1::uuid AS job_id,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated) AS failure_recorded,
  (SELECT status FROM updated LIMIT 1) AS status,
  (SELECT current_stage FROM updated LIMIT 1) AS current_stage,
  COALESCE((SELECT last_error FROM updated LIMIT 1), LEFT($2::text, 4000)) AS last_error;
